days.title: Colorado Springs — Pikes Peak + Garden of Gods

hotel.name: The Academy Hotel Colorado Springs
hotel.address: 8110 N Academy Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80920
hotel.notes: Free made-to-order breakfast. Indoor pool. Request upper floor. 20-30 min to Cog Railway.

activities.title: Depart Hotel — Drive to Manitou Springs
activities.description: Leave by 6:45 AM sharp. ~1 hr 45 min drive to the Cog Railway depot. Arrive at 8:30 AM to park — parking fills up fast on weekends. Be at the platform by 8:45 AM for the 9:05 AM train.

driveInfo.via: I-25 S → Hwy 24 W → Ruxton Ave
driveInfo.note: Allow extra time on weekends — parking lot at depot can back up. Arrive 8:30 AM to be safe.

activities.title: Pikes Peak Cog Railway — ✓ Booked
activities.description: Board train. Sit LEFT side going up — Car 1, Row 15, Seats A, B, C (already assigned). 40 min at summit (14,115 ft). Buy famous cinnamon donuts at summit. Photos first — gift shop last. Back at depot by 1:30 PM. Running late or need to adjust? Call visitor services at +17196855401 — if you alert them before the train leaves, they can check real-time availability for a later train and sometimes switch your slot right over the phone, saving you a stressful rush!
tips: ✓ BOOKED — Car 1, Row 15, Seats A · B · C
Depart hotel 6:45 AM — arrive depot 8:30 AM — be on platform by 8:45 AM
Sit LEFT side going up — seats already face the best views
Bring layers — summit is 30°F cooler than base
Photos first, donuts second, gift shop last
📞 Running late? Call +17196855401 immediately — they can switch you to a later train slot before departure

flag.text: Confirmed. If anything comes up, call +17196855401 — alerting them before the train leaves gives you the best chance of switching to a later slot stress-free.

activities.title: Garden of the Gods
activities.description: Free entry. Scenic loop drive 30-45 min. Perkins Central Garden Trail (1.5 mi easy, 45 min). Siamese Twins Trail adds geological arch views. Allow 2.5 hrs total.

activities.title: Red Rock Canyon Open Space
activities.description: Same red sandstone formations as Garden of Gods but without tourist crowds. Mesa Trail (easy, 1.5 mi). Views back toward Garden of Gods. Local favorite — genuinely underrated.
activities.address: 3550 W High St, Colorado Springs, CO 80904

activities.title: Check Into Academy Hotel
activities.description: Indoor pool for your daughter. Arcade. Dinner options on-site or nearby.
activities.address: 8110 N Academy Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80920

days.title: Colorado Springs → Buena Vista → Glenwood Springs

driveFromPrevious.via: US-24 W → Buena Vista → Twin Lakes → US-24 N → Leadville → I-70 W → Glenwood Springs

hotel.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Glenwood Springs
hotel.notes: All-suite with full kitchenettes. Free daily breakfast. Indoor heated pool + hot tub. Local bus to Aspen directly behind hotel. Parking $12/day.

activities.title: Late Start — Depart Colorado Springs via US-24 West
activities.description: Relaxed morning — no early alarm today. Head west on US-24 through Woodland Park. The road follows the Arkansas River valley with views of the Collegiate Peaks (all 14ers). ~95 miles to Buena Vista, roughly 2 hrs.

driveInfo.via: US-24 W through Woodland Park → Trout Creek Pass → Buena Vista

activities.title: Lunch at CO Ranch House — Buena Vista
activities.description: Ranch-style comfort food in the heart of downtown Buena Vista. Burgers, sandwiches, and Colorado staples. Great stop mid-drive before heading up into the mountains.

activities.title: Twin Lakes — Mountain View Overlook
activities.description: Park at the Mountain View Overlook — a paved pullout on the north (right) side of CO-82, 2.8 miles west of the US-24 junction. Large brown scenic byway signs mark the spot. Walk to the lake edge for the postcard Mt. Elbert reflection shot — Colorado's highest peak at 14,440 ft reflected in the reservoir. Allow 20–30 min.

driveInfo.via: US-24 N → Leadville → I-70 W → Glenwood Springs

activities.title: Check Into Residence Inn Glenwood Springs
activities.description: Check in and unpack. Full kitchen — settle in. You're here 2 nights. Conf: 73462520918893.

activities.title: ★ Grizzly Creek Trail — Easy 30-Min Evening Hike
activities.description: Best short hike in Glenwood Canyon. Drive 10 min east on I-70 to Grizzly Creek Rest Area (Exit 121). Walk the flat canyon-floor trail ~0.7 miles in — sheer 1,500 ft sandstone walls on both sides, turquoise Colorado River beside you. Zero elevation gain. Turn back whenever ready. Perfect leg-stretch after a long drive day. Kids love the creek.
activities.address: Grizzly Creek Rest Area, I-70 Exit 121, Glenwood Canyon, CO 81601
tips: Exit 121 off I-70 East — Grizzly Creek Rest Area
Flat canyon-floor trail — easy for all ages, no gear needed
Best in evening light — golden canyon walls glow
No fee, no permit, no reservation

days.title: Maroon Bells + Downtown Aspen + Silver Queen Gondola

hotel.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Glenwood Springs

activities.title: Depart Glenwood — Drive to Aspen Highlands
activities.description: Leave by 7AM. 30 miles via Hwy 82. Arrive Welcome Center by 7:45AM. Park in garage ($40 max for the day). Board 8AM shuttle.

activities.title: Maroon Bells — Round Trip Shuttle ✓ Booked
activities.description: Shuttle departs 9:15AM from Aspen Highlands Welcome Center. 15 min ride. At Maroon Bells by 9:30AM. Maroon Lake Scenic Loop (0.5 mi flat — perfect for all ages). Crater Lake Trail (3.6 mi RT, moderate, 500 ft gain) if energy allows. HARD STOP: Be back at lake heading to shuttle by 12:30PM.
activities.address: Maroon Bells Scenic Area, Aspen, CO 81611
tips: ✓ BOOKED — Be at Aspen Highlands Welcome Center by 9:00AM
Return shuttles are first-come-first-served — last shuttle down is 5PM
Pack trail lunch from hotel — café at Bells is overpriced
Hard weather stop at 12:30PM — do not be on exposed trail after this
No swimming in Maroon Lake

flag.text: ✓ Confirmed. See CMBR.pdf in Passes tab for your reservation confirmation.

activities.via: Maroon Creek Rd → Hwy 82 to Aspen

activities.title: Lunch in Aspen — White House Tavern / NY Pizza / Big Wrap
activities.description: Pick one: White House Tavern (kale salad, chicken sandwich — upscale casual), New York Pizza (cheap, quick slices on Hyman Ave), or Big Wrap (fastest — veggie wraps, great for kids). All within 2 blocks of the gondola base.

activities.title: John Denver Sanctuary
activities.description: Free riverside park with sculptural rock installations and John Denver song lyrics embedded throughout. Open dawn to dusk. Emotional and peaceful — meaningful for the whole family. 20 min visit.

activities.title: Silver Queen Gondola — Aspen Mountain
activities.description: 18-min gondola from downtown Aspen to 11,212 ft. Panoramic views of four mountain ranges. Sundeck restaurant at top. Last ride up 4PM — do not be late. Family Sightseeing Package: 2 adults + up to 4 kids.
tips: Last gondola up at 4PM — arrive by 3:45PM at latest

flag.text: Last ride up 4PM. Leave Maroon Bells by 12:30PM to make it.

activities.title: Cooper Street Mall — Ice Cream + Walk
activities.description: Walkable pedestrian downtown. Ice cream at Paradise Bakery (unanimous local pick). Kids fountain to play in. Window shopping, galleries. Easy wind-down after the biggest day of the trip.

activities.title: Dinner Back in Glenwood — Modern Brava / Masala & Curry / The Pullman
activities.description: Drive back (~45 min) then dinner. Modern Brava Trattoria (upscale Italian, great risotto), Masala & Curry (Indian, vegetarian-friendly, highly rated), or The Pullman (New American, lively, best deviled eggs). All on Grand Ave.

days.title: Glenwood Springs Full Day — Rafting + Hot Springs

hotel.name: Glenwood Hot Springs Resort
hotel.checkIn: Check out Residence Inn by 12PM, Check into Resort
hotel.notes: Unlimited pool access included. Sopris Splash Zone for kids. Request ground floor with patio access, pool-facing side, away from elevators.

activities.title: Pre-Rafting: Load Car + Request Late Checkout
activities.description: Checkout clash alert — you check out of Residence Inn today but rafting runs 9 AM–noon. Fix it now: Either (A) request a 1:00 PM late checkout from the front desk tonight or first thing in the morning — most hotels grant this for free if asked early; OR (B) pack all bags into the SUV before 8:30 AM so your room is clear before you leave for rafting.

flag.text: ⚠️ Ask Residence Inn for 1:00 PM late checkout tonight (Day 4) — or load bags into SUV before heading to rafting. Don't leave this until the morning of!

activities.title: White Water Rafting — Shoshone Rapids
activities.description: Blue Sky Adventures half-day Colorado River trip. Class III Shoshone Rapids in June (snowmelt keeps water high). Baptism, Tuttle's Tumble, Tombstone, The Wall, Maneater rapids. Wildlife: bighorn sheep, bald eagles, marmots. Done by noon. Tuesday departure is 9 AM.
tips: Minimum age 5+ — your daughter is fine at 10
Apply sunscreen to TOP of legs, arms, shoulders before getting in
Life jackets provided
Book in advance — June is peak season

activities.title: Checkout Residence Inn → Lunch → Check Into Hot Springs Resort
activities.description: Check out by noon. Lunch nearby — Sal Mex Restaurant (Mexican) or Sweet Coloradough (donuts + coffee, 2430 S Glen Ave). Then check into Glenwood Hot Springs Resort (Conf: 1042873). Pool access included — no extra booking needed.

activities.title: Glenwood Hot Springs Pool
activities.description: Unlimited access included with Lodge room. No reservations needed, no time limit, hand stamp for re-entry. Sopris Splash Zone: water slides + fountains for your daughter. Grand Pool for adults. Open daily 8AM–10PM.
activities.address: 401 N River Street, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601
tips: Get to pool early to claim chairs
Hand stamp for re-entry

activities.title: Glenwood Hot Springs Resort — Evening Soak
activities.description: Head back to the pool for an evening session. Sopris Splash Zone still open until 10PM for the kids. Grand Pool for adults. Hand stamp for unlimited re-entry — no need to book anything extra.
activities.address: 401 N River Street, Glenwood Springs, CO 81601

days.title: Glenwood Springs → Red Rocks → Fly Home

driveFromPrevious.via: I-70 East → Morrison → C-470 → Peña Blvd → DEN

activities.title: Check Out & Depart Glenwood Springs
activities.description: Pack the night before to ensure a smooth departure. Check out of Glenwood Hot Springs Resort by 11:00 AM and begin driving east immediately. Skip Silverthorne, Frisco, Idaho Springs, and all other intermediate stops to avoid Summit County congestion and minimize the risk of delays on I-70.

driveInfo.via: I-70 East through Glenwood Canyon → Vail Pass → Eisenhower Tunnel → Morrison
driveInfo.note: No sightseeing stops. This strategy provides additional buffer time for Denver traffic and airport procedures.

flag.text: Skipping Summit County stops reduces stress and significantly lowers the risk of missing your flight due to I-70 traffic.

activities.title: Lunch at Morrison Inn
activities.description: Classic Mexican restaurant located in the heart of Morrison. Family-friendly atmosphere with excellent vegetarian options including cheese enchiladas, veggie fajitas, chile rellenos, quesadillas, rice, and beans. A relaxing lunch after clearing the mountain corridor.
tips: Vegetarian-friendly menu with multiple meat-free options
Located only 5 minutes from Red Rocks
Street parking available nearby
Arriving after the mountain drive helps avoid rushing through lunch

activities.via: Morrison Rd → Red Rocks Park Rd

activities.title: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre
activities.description: Free daytime entry. Explore the iconic amphitheater, visit the Colorado Music Hall of Fame, climb the famous 192 amphitheater steps, and enjoy panoramic views toward Denver. If energy allows, walk part of the Trading Post Trail through the dramatic red sandstone formations.
tips: No reservation required during daytime hours
Visitor Center and Colorado Music Hall of Fame open 7 AM–7 PM
Trading Post Trail is an easy 1.4-mile loop
The amphitheater stairs make for a memorable family photo
Denver skyline views are spectacular on clear afternoons

flag.text: Depart Red Rocks by 5:00 PM to maintain a comfortable airport buffer.

activities.title: Return Rental Car at DEN
activities.description: Follow signs to the DEN Rental Car Center off Peña Boulevard. Staff typically accepts keys curbside, making the process quick and efficient. Complimentary shuttle buses run every few minutes to the terminal.
activities.address: DEN Rental Car Center, 8500 Peña Blvd, Denver, CO 80249

activities.title: Check In & Clear Security
activities.description: Use Southwest mobile boarding passes or self-service kiosks. Proceed through security and head to Concourse C. You'll have ample time before boarding to relax and enjoy dinner inside the airport.
activities.address: Denver International Airport — Concourse C, Denver, CO 80249

activities.title: Farewell Dinner Inside DEN
activities.description: Enjoy a relaxed final meal after clearing security. Root Down is a local favorite with excellent vegetarian choices, while other Concourse C dining options offer quick and convenient alternatives.
activities.address: Denver International Airport — Concourse C, Denver, CO 80249
tips: Root Down offers several vegetarian dishes
Dining after security eliminates traffic-related stress
Charge devices and refill water bottles before boarding

activities.title: WN #1324 Departs DEN → STL
activities.description: Board Southwest Flight 1324 for the journey home. Reflect on an unforgettable Colorado adventure filled with mountains, hot springs, rafting, Aspen, and Red Rocks.
